name: Manacles
summary: Utilize: bind a Small or Medium creature (DC 13 Sleight of Hand); bound creatures attack with Disadvantage.
text: As a Utilize action, you can bind an unwilling Small or Medium creature within 5 feet of you that has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition, if you succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check. A bound creature has Disadvantage on attack rolls, and it has the Restrained condition if the Manacles are fastened to a fixed chain or hook. Escaping takes an action and a successful DC 20 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check; breaking them takes an action and a successful DC 25 Strength (Athletics) check. The Manacles come with a key; without it, a creature using Thieves' Tools can pick their lock with a DC 15 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check.
